deviations.from: T348's footer-truncation bullet: 'Verify with a guest list longer than one page, in French, at 360-375px.'
deviations.to: e2e/layout/footer-truncation.spec.ts runs at 320x568 (iPhone SE's own viewport) instead.
deviations.reason: Measured empirically (Playwright, WebKit) that the French two-string footer does not overflow or wrap its container at 360-375px even with realistic-to-extreme totals (tried 2 through 6 digits on both 'shown' and 'total', up to guestCount:5000/pageSize:1234) once font-swap settles (document.fonts.ready) - the current padding/token values leave more margin at that width than the bullet's framing implies. The defect (each span wrapping onto a second line rather than the container overflowing horizontally - confirmed via getBoundingClientRect() height doubling and getClientRects().length) only reproduced at 320px with a guest count echoing T341's own 104-guest example, and even then only reliably once the initial font-swap reflow had settled - an earlier unsettled-font measurement looked like it reproduced at 360px too, which did not hold up under repeated, font-ready-gated runs.
deviations.authorized_by: T348's own footer-truncation bullet framing ('It cannot be device-verified...Consider covering it that way' is offered as a suggestion, not a mandate on the exact figure) plus task-management skill S5 ('deviate minimally, staying inside the task's intent') - 320px is still one of CLAUDE.md hard rule 4's four target devices and the narrower of the two, so it stays inside 'narrow viewport in French', just not the literal 360-375 range.
deviations.verified_how: Repeated Playwright runs (single-project and all-four-project) at 320px with document.fonts.ready awaited before measuring: 4/4 and 3x-repeated single-project runs all consistent. At 360px with the same content and settled fonts, neither the fixed nor the reverted CSS wrapped or overflowed in any of ~8 tried scenarios - see the spec's own header comment for the full account.
